faqs.q: How do I find my photos if I attended a large event?
faqs.a: Moments provides two ultra-fast methods: 1) Upload a selfie so our facial recognition AI automatically locates every photo you appear in. 2) Or filter by your bib/jersey number in sports events or by time and venue.

faqs.q: What quality do I receive the purchased photos in?
faqs.a: You receive the original ultra-high-resolution file (JPG or RAW depending on the photographer), completely free from destructive compression and 100% watermark-free.

faqs.q: What payment methods are available in Latin America and Colombia?
faqs.a: We accept 100% secure payments via Mercado Pago across Latin America (local credit/debit cards, bank transfers, Pix in Brazil, SPEI in Mexico) and Wompi in Colombia (PSE, Nequi, Bancolombia), plus balance in your Moments wallet.

faqs.q: How does the Moments PRO membership work?
faqs.a: Moments PRO is a monthly subscription giving you unlimited AI facial recognition, cloud download priority, watermark-free previews, and early access to newly published galleries.

faqs.q: How can I apply as an official photographer?
faqs.a: Visit our 'For Photographers' section or /photographer-access. After a quick portfolio verification, you can create events, upload protected photos, and receive payments straight to your bank account.
